brand.name: FITKEY
brand.campaign_line: Ab gym ka ek hi pass.
brand.platform_note: Android only. Never show an App Store badge or say 'iOS'.
voice: Confident, warm, a little cheeky. A gym friend who hypes you up, not a guru who lectures.
Short lines. Read every headline aloud; if it needs a breath, cut it.
Hinglish only where it lands harder than English (ek hi pass, ghar ka khana, Mummy-Papa, rank dekh lo). Never force it into feature explanations.
Premium but not snobby: real Indian life — parks, societies, thalis, office leaderboards.
Show the product doing the work: camera counts reps, Mansi reads the photo, QR checks you in.
truth_rules: No user, venue, download, rating or result numbers. Say 'gyms, pools & studios near you'.
No testimonials, reviews, press logos, celebrity or influencer names unless signed and real.
No medical claims or guaranteed weight loss. Mansi is 'an AI coach, not a doctor'.
Avoid the word 'free'. The pass is paid. Studio videos and Mansi are 'in the app'. Coin rewards are real but conditional (see refer rules).
Meal-scan values are 'AI estimates'. Say 'estimated', never 'exact'.
Never name or imply a competitor.

fact_sheet.pass: FitKey pass comes two ways: coins (pay per visit, each centre has its own coin cost) or sessions (a fixed number of visits at any centre within validity). Covers gyms, pools, yoga studios, dance, MMA/martial arts and sports clubs listed on FITKEY.
fact_sheet.booking: Book a slot, then check in by scanning the venue's QR or entering the desk code. Cancel before the slot and the coins or session come back.
fact_sheet.proveit: Phone camera counts pushups, squats and pullups and times planks; the plank timer pauses on bad form. Levels earn a badge + ProveIt coins the first time. Unlimited is one all-out set; your best Unlimited set is your All India Rank (Unlimited earns no coins). Only full-range reps are counted. Reps are counted on the phone; no video is recorded or uploaded (proof clips are OFF in the app; never claim them). After a set you get a branded ProveIt share card (Story 9:16 or Post 4:5) showing your set, badge and All India Rank or city rank; post it to FitFeed or share to WhatsApp, Instagram or any app. ProveIt coins are spent in the FitKey Store.
fact_sheet.mansi: AI fitness & diet coach. Knows your goal, daily calorie/protein targets, what you logged today and your recent check-ins. Accepts a photo: meal, nutrition label, form or equipment. Indian, budget-friendly, veg ideas. Stays on fitness/nutrition/wellness topics.
fact_sheet.meal_scan: Snap your plate: dishes identified, portions estimated, calories/protein/carbs/fat in seconds. Or snap a packaged-food nutrition label. Edit name/servings before saving. Barcode scan also available.
fact_sheet.fuel_log: Indian food database (roti, poha, dal etc.), cooked dishes, raw ingredients, packaged foods; fibre, vitamins and minerals; water tracker; daily targets from your goal.
fact_sheet.studio: Coach-led workout videos in the app: yoga, strength, dance, HIIT and more.
fact_sheet.community: Circles: local morning walks, yoga, laughter clubs in your park or society; Hindi labels, large text, voice notes, QR-poster attendance, members without a phone, family follow for streaks. FitFeed: photo posts, before/after journeys with stats & timeline, on-device face blur, blogs from verified trainers & nutritionists. Events: city, office & campus events with leaderboards; Trophy board. Gym Buddy: match with members at the same venue and time.
fact_sheet.refer: Share your code; when a friend signs up with it you both get referral coins (locked). They go live when the friend buys any FitKey pass. Referral coins pay up to 50% of a pass, or use them in the Store. Do not print a coin amount (it is configurable).
fact_sheet.more: Book verified, certified trainers (online, at home, at a partner gym). FitKey Store: whey, gear & wearables, cash on delivery, live tracking. HealthStop: clinics, sports medicine & physio, chemists near you.
